$comment: Beispiel-Payloads für Redesigner+Jev-Gates. Keine Keys hier. Lokal: export TYPESAFE_API_KEY=… und POST https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone (model: jev-latest). Jev ist ein Entscheidungsmodell — Propositions, keine Code-Generierung.

lock.purpose: Schritt 01 — DESIGN.md vollständig mit Werten, bevor UI gebaut wird.
lock.state: Type A static portfolio for Klaas Leeck. DESIGN.md committed first. Composition Verzeichnis, grid 8fr/4fr, palette stone paper #E5E0D4 accent #3B6B4F, signature weight-shift, ausbau ausgestattet, card language hairline, icon set Tabler, Du address.

conditions.proposition: The lock sheet specifies architecture type A static with no CMS, auth, shop, or generative AI product surface.
Exactly one landing composition archetype is locked (Verzeichnis) rather than a generic hero-plus-three-cards skeleton.
The grid is specified as a ratio such as 8fr/4fr, not 1fr 1fr or three equal columns.
The accent is not a fingerprint blue/violet/emerald or zinc-950, and not redesigner.lol pink on near-black.
A single named signature moment includes build values, fallback, reduced-motion end state, and a mobile rule.

craft.purpose: Schritt 04 — Ausstattung mit Werten, nicht Nachmittag-Leere.
craft.state: Hairline rows, Tabler 1.5px four sizes, process line, FAQ accordion, shine+press CTA, sticky mobile action, initials plate, honest empty proof slots, one dark contact band.

conditions.proposition: A single icon set is used with stroke 1.5px and icons that name content rather than sparkles or shields as decoration.
The page uses one card language (hairline) rather than mixing glass-rim and shelf cards.
Locked furniture is built with concrete values (padding 0.9rem, 1px rule, CTA shine 3.2s, FAQ 200ms, header blur after 24px).
The page is not type-on-a-field only: it has icons, states, a process, FAQ, and a sticky mobile CTA.

antislop.purpose: Schritt 06 — Median-Tells UND Nachmittags-Tells. Ab 4 Treffern neu entscheiden.
antislop.state: German Du copy. Three real cases only. Placeholders labeled. No Lenis. No Google Fonts CDN. No ghost word. No three noun feature cards. No fake Trusted by.

conditions.proposition: Swapping the name and accent would not produce a plausible dentist or crypto-wallet landing; the directory/spec composition is specific to this person.
The first viewport is not badge plus huge H1 plus paragraph plus filled CTA plus ghost Mehr erfahren, and there is no pink pill on black.
There are no invented logos, years, reviews, HRB numbers, or Trusted-by claims.
There is at most one primary wow in the first viewport; prefers-reduced-motion maps to the end state; no Lenis under 768px.

ship.purpose: Schritt 07 + Build — Legal zum Stack, dist läuft, Config dokumentiert.
ship.state: Impressum DDG, Datenschutz lists Netlify/Cloudflare, local fonts, form consent+honeypot or mailto. npm run build emits dist. README in German.

conditions.proposition: Impressum cites DDG not TMG, Datenschutz lists only processors that actually ship, and there is no dead EU ODR link.
The contact form includes a required consent checkbox linking to Datenschutz, a honeypot, and length limits.
The site does not claim to be a generative AI product and does not show an Article 50 badge merely because an agent wrote HTML.
The static build completes and writes to dist for Cloudflare Pages and Netlify.
